question: Who among the following received the National Award for ‘Best Music Direction’ in September 2022 for his song 'Marange Toh Vahin Jaa Kar' in the documentary film '1232 KMs'?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Vishal Bharadwaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishal Bharadwaj** is a renowned Indian film director, screenwriter, producer, music composer, and playback singer.
 
• He received the prestigious **National Award for 'Best Music Direction'** in **September 2022** for his work on the song '**Marange Toh Vahin Jaa Kar**' featured in the documentary film '**1232 KMs**'.
 
• The documentary '**1232 KMs**' highlights the struggles of migrant workers during the **COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in India**.
 
• The song '**Marange Toh Vahin Jaa Kar**' captures the emotional essence and hardships faced by these workers.
 
• **Vishal Bharadwaj** is known for his unique style of composing soulful music, often blending Indian classical and contemporary tunes.
 
• He has previously won several **National Film Awards** for his contributions to Indian cinema, including awards for films like '**Omkara**' and '**Haider**'.
 
• This recognition further cements his position as one of India's most versatile and talented music composers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Amit Trivedi**__

 __
 
• **Amit Trivedi** is another celebrated Indian music composer, singer, and lyricist known for his innovative music style.
 
• He has worked on various acclaimed films such as '**Dev.D**', '**Queen**', and '**Lootera**'.
 
• Although highly talented, he was not associated with the documentary '**1232 KMs**'.
 
 
 
• **Swanand Kirkire**__
 __
 
• **Swanand Kirkire** is a noted lyricist, playback singer, and actor in the Indian film industry.
 
• He is a two-time **National Film Award** winner for Best Lyrics but primarily focuses on songwriting rather than music composition.
 
 
 
• **Ajay-Atul**__
 
 
• **Ajay-Atul** is a music director duo from Maharashtra, known for their work in Marathi and Hindi cinema.
 
• They gained national fame for composing music for films like '**Sairat**' and '**Agneepath**'.
 
• They were not involved in the making of the song '**Marange Toh Vahin Jaa Kar**'.
